Excuse Generator

Need an excuse? Pick work, school, or social — then mild, bold, or outrageous — for a ready-made alibi in one click.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a category and a severity level.
  2. Press Generate Excuse.
  3. Click any excuse to copy it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What categories and severities are there?

Work, school, and social — each with mild (believable), bold (suspicious), and outrageous (hilarious) excuse banks.

Are these excuses meant to be used for real?

These are for fun and fiction. Mild ones are plausible; outrageous ones are deliberately absurd.

How do I copy an excuse?

Click any excuse or its Copy button to copy it instantly.
